capabilities: Sync a public IMDb list (watchlist, ratings, or other lists) into vault notes
Fetch additional metadata like posters, writers and plots from OMDb
Render each note from a user-defined mustache template
Optionally overwrite existing notes on the next sync
disambiguation: Not a movie lookup or reference tool; it only imports items from your own public IMDb lists into notes.
extras: The IMDb list must be public for the plugin to download and parse it; an OMDb key is recommended but optional.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of the Booksidian plugin, which I change things around for the IMDb usecase.
motivation: The author forked Booksidian and adapted it for the IMDb use case.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import IMDb watchlists or ratings as structured notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of the Booksidian plugin
OMDb is queried to fetch additional information such as Posters, Writers, Plot descriptions
You can either use the Template plugin that Obsidian provides or Templater

summary: IMDb list syncer that creates a note for each item in a public IMDb list, enriched with OMDb data.
